༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying thig las phrin las kyi byang bu tshogs gnyis chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// thugs rje chen po rtsa gsum snying thig las phrin las kyi byang bu tshogs gnyis chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru lo ke shwa ra ya/ mtshan tsam thos pas srid pa'i rtsa ba bcad// sku la dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing sku rdzogs// gsung gi rig sngags bzlas pas rnam grol thob// sangs rgyas padma'i gtso bos 'gro 'di skyongs// gang gi sgrub thabs kun gyi bcud// rgya mtsho lnga yi dkyil 'khor gyi// phrin las bde chen gsang lam 'dir// blo ldan spro bas zhugs shig kye// zab lam 'di'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel bar phrin las kyi rim pa la 'jug par 'dod pas yo byad kyi gshom ni/ bsnyen sgrub dang dbang bskur rnams la so so'i skabs dang bstun/ dkyus la sman gtor rakta phyi mchod rnams bsham/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang 'bul gtor sogs tshogs par bya/ phrin las dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro /dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi las rim mo// dang po la/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ snang ba mtha' yas gar dbang spyan ras gzigs// padma 'byung gnas yum mchog mtsho rgyal ma// grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje bdud 'joms la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs// zab gter sgo 'byed gar dbang zla rgyal mtshan// nyi zla klong gsal chos dbang rdo rje 'dzin// phrin las rnam rgyal padma 'jigs bral la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs// dbang phyug rgyal po kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi// chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang// rtsa brgyud bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs// phyi nang snang zhen chos nyid ngang du dag /sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes 'khor lor rdzogs// ma btsal lhun grub sku bzhi'i 'bras bur smin// 'khor ba dong sprugs 'jig rten mgon gyur shog / skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo: mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: 'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar: dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo ste: bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi:

sku gsum dngos grub kun gyi bdag: yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi: bar chad kun sel grogs mdzad ma: mkha' 'gro rnams la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: bdag gis sems can kun don du: 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar: pha ma rigs drug sems can rnams: sdug bsngal dag las bskyab pa'i phyir: theg mchog lam bzang 'dir zhugs nas: lha mchog thugs rje chen po bsgom: ma ṇi'i sgra dbyangs 'gro rnams skyabs: tshad med bzhi ldan rmang bting nas: smon 'jug gnyis kyi lam sbyangs te: rigs drug sbyin pa rnam bzhis bskyang: sku gsum thob par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ tshogs gsag pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gshegs: spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: sgo gsum dad pas gus phyag 'tshal: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: sdom gsum nyams chag 'gal gyur bshags: dge ba mchog la bdag yi rang: 'gro ba gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol: dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo: bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ bsang sbyang byin rlabs 'gugs pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas bsngo ba rnams spyi mthun byas la/ bka' bsgo zhing mtshams bcad pa ni/ hrī: nga ni dpal chen khro rgyal rta mgrin te: rta skad rngam 'tsher bar chad ma lus sel: rab 'jigs sku yi sprul pas bar chad sel: ye shes me ri 'bar bas phyogs mtshams gang: gdon bgegs 'byung po zhes bya'i ming yang med: log rtog ma rig 'khrul pa'i sems can la: lha dang 'dre zhes bzang ngan gnyis snang yang: rnam dag sems nyid ye grol spros med la: gnyis 'dzin 'dre bgegs zhes bya ga la srid: rnam rtog a 'thas gnyis snang bgegs su shar: bar chad gdon bgegs rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid ma bcos thugs rje chen po'i thugs: stong gsal rang rig klong du mtshams bcad do: hrīḥbadzra kro ta hya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa: mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru las: 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis: mchod rdzas 'bags btsog dngos 'dzin sbyangs: rigs lnga 'od zhu byang sems bdud rtsi dang: 'khor 'das yongs grol raktar bltams: 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor tshogs spungs: zag med dpag yas mchod sprin gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa rakta bha liṃ ta ma hā pū tsa sa ma ye hūm̐: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i thog ma dam tshig pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ: byams pa chen po tshad med ngang las ni: ā: snying rje kun khyab tshad med 'ja' tshon 'khrigs: hūm̐: sprul sku'i snying rjes sems can kun la khyab: hrī: sku lnga yongs rdzogs dag pa'i ngo bor bsam: de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams mchod: snod la phog pas 'byung bzhi'i dngos po sbyangs: 'od lnga las grub gzhal yas khang du gyur: 'od zer tshur 'dus bdag lus rnam smin sbyangs: padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs ngang nyid las: snying rje'i bdag po thugs rje chen po'i sku: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa: thabs shes dbyer med rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar: g.yas 'og padma rā ga'i phreng ba 'dren: g.yon 'og me tog padma'i yu ba 'dzin: zhabs gnyis mnyam nyid skyil mo krung du bzhugs: dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du brdzes: sna tshogs dar gyi cod pan ze prog can: mgur chu phyag zhabs ratna'i rgyan gyis spras: zhal 'dzum brtse bas 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs: gsal stong dngos med nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar bskyed: g.yas su pad nyi bam ro'i gdan steng du: yi dam dpa' bo rta mgrin khro bo'i rgyal: sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i: g.yas pas padma ḍā ru nam mkhar 'khrol: g.yon pas lcags sgrog dngul dkar dril bu gsil: dbu skra dmar ser gyen brdzes thod skam brgyan: spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher:

smin ma sma ra rab 'khyil me stag 'phro: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche gtsigs rkan sgra rdeb: rab 'jigs dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol: rngam brjid dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i dbus na 'gying: gar stabs shigs se me dpung klong na bzhugs: hrī: g.yon du padma nyi zla bam ro'i steng: rgyal yum gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: mche gtsigs smin ma dmar ser spyan gsum bgrad: g.yas g.yon phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: dbu skra sil bu'i lcang lo thur du grol: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes pa la: spyi gtsug phag zhal nag mo ngur sgra 'byin: pheṃ pheṃ ā ralli yi sgra sgrog cing: rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbus nyid na: me dpung klong na gar stabs tshul du bzhugs: hrī: rang gi spyi gtsug padma nyi zla'i steng: bde gshegs kun 'dus padma 'byung gnas bdag: sku mdog mthing nag gzi brjid 'od 'bar zhing: dbu skra gyen brdzes dar sna'i phod kyis bcing: a tsar cha lugs rus pa'i rgyan drug mnabs: g.yas kyi phyag na seng ldeng ḍā ru 'khrol: g.yon gyi phyag na dngul dkar dril bu gsil: lo brgyad bzhon tshul gar stabs 'od zer 'khyil: skyil krung zil phrom byin rlabs bde drod 'bar: rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dbus na lham mer bsam: rgyab tu bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams: bka' nyan las byed phrin las kun sgrub cing: 'od zer me stag rab 'khrugs gar nyams 'khyugs: cha lugs ma nges rngam 'khrugs tshul du bsam: mdun du pha ma rigs drug sems can rnams: gus 'dud dge bas ma ṇi'i pad dbyangs ldir: snang srid ye rdzogs lhun grub rang bzhin la: ma 'gags rol pa'i tshul du gsal bar bsgom: ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ spos bsreg rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la: o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams:

padma ge sar sdong po la: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes: padma 'byung gnas zhes su grags: 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: bsil tshal ta la o rgyan yul: rdo rje gdan dang ma ga ta: a su stag tshang seng phug nas: sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad gshegs su gsol: hrī: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: hrī: shar phyogs po ta la yi zhing*// ngo mtshar bkod pa khyad par 'phags// ye shes rang snang pho brang nas// 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sogs// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor// gnas mchog 'di ru spyan 'dren gyis// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: gtso bo'i spyan 'dren ma dper chad pa bsabs kyang*/ phyin chad gter gzhung dngos rnyed na de bri dgos/ hrī: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas khang: chos 'byung 'bar ba'i gdan steng nas: rngam brjid nga ros dgra bgegs 'dul: khro rgyal gtso bo he ru ka: dpal chen rta mgrin 'jigs pa'i sku: gnas mchog 'di ru spyan 'dren gyis: byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: hrī: dur khrod gnas brgyad bam ro'i steng: dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum: gsang ba ye shes ḍā ki'i gtso: khro 'dzum chags pa'i gzhon tshul can: ḍā ki'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phobs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: hrī: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang:

chos skyong dam can gter bdag rnams: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phobs la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: badzra gu ru ha ya ghrī wa dhu ma gha ye ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐ hrīṃ hrīṃ: bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: rang bzhin stong gsum gzhal yas yangs pa'i nang: rin chen sna lnga seng ge padma dang: dar zab nyi zla rab brjid khri steng du: byams mgon rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes 'dzum gzi brjid mdangs ldan bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: sgrib sbyang tshogs gnyis gsag pa'i phyir: lus ngag yid gsum rab dad pas: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti dzaḥho: mchod pa 'bul ba la phyi mchod ni/ hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan mchod pa rnams: rtsa gsum lha la mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke ghandhe nai widyā shabda pū tsa ho: nang mchod ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po'i me tog gsur chen spos: zhun chen snang gsal dri chu dang: sha chen zhal zas rkang gling rnams: dug gsum sku gsum phyag rgya gar: dug lnga ye shes lngar bsgyur te: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas rang sems rtogs par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: gsang mchod ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang ba thabs kyi yab mchog dang:

shes rab stong pa'i yum sbyor bas: gnyis med mkha' gsang sbyor mtshams nas: bde chen dkar dmar bde chen rgyun: zung 'jug ro snyoms zag pa med: bde gsal snang stong rig stong dang: grags stong mi rtog mchod par 'bul: gzi mdangs rgyas phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: bdud rtsi sman mchod ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni: rtsa brgyad lo 'dab stong sbyar ba'i: tshogs brgyad nyon mongs stong dag phyir: dgyes mdzad bdud rtsi ro brgya ldan: yon tan brjod 'das mchod pa 'di: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: 'dir spro na brgyud 'debs tshig rkang bzhi pa la/ sman mchod 'bul lo thugs rjes bdag byin rlobs// zhes bsgyur la brgyud mchod bya/ rakta khrag mchod ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bdag 'dzin bsgral pa'i bhandha ru: zhing bcu bsgral pa'i khrag gis bkang: 'dod chags rang dag rba klong la: zhe sdang bsgral ba'i lhu dum 'phyo: gti mug bsgral ba'i zhag chen 'khyil: skye 'chi rtsad gcod rakta 'di: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: ma hā rakta khā hi: dam rdzas gtor mchod ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: ba liṃ gtor mchod 'bul ba ni: snang ba snod kyi 'jig rten du: khams gsum rigs drug gtor mar bshams: yongs grol 'dzin dag gtor ma 'di: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: sarba bha liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi: yongs grol don mchod ni/ hrī: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha tshogs la: dug lnga rang grol mchod pa ni: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug sogs: bde stong gsal stong rig stong dang:

grags stong dran stong rnam dag pa'i: dug lnga ye shes rang grol 'di: rtsa gsum thugs rje'i lha la 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: ma hā sarba pū tsa ho: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrī: ma bcos rang byung rgyu rkyen bral ba'i ngang: thugs rjes rang byung pad sdong rtse las byon: skyon med gzhom gzhig mi mnga' rdo rje'i sku: padma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: padma sambha rig gnas kun la mkhas: blo ldan mchog sred yon tan kun tu rgyas: padma rgyal pos rgyal srid chos la bkod: nyi ma 'od zer 'khrul pa'i sbubs nas thon: shākya seng ges bdud bcom bstan pa spel: seng ge sgra sgrog mu stegs dam sri btul: rdo rje gro lod sprul pas bod khams 'dul: sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum 'byon bzhugs rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams: thugs rje'i rgya mtsho byin rlabs sprin phung 'thibs: skal ldan lam sna 'dren mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon: sku gsum bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi: thugs kyi dgongs pa longs pa'i pad 'byung gis: bdag dang mos pa'i gang zag thams cad la: dbang bskur byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin phobs: ma rig bdag cag khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams: ma hā gu ru khyed kyi thugs rjes zungs: hrī: byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed snying rje'i bdag: spyan ras gzigs kyi 'od zer 'gro la gzigs: zhal 'dzum sgra dbyangs ma ṇi'i chos sgra sgrog: shangs nas ye shes rlung gis dug lnga 'thor: byams mgon thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: yan lag drug cu ma nges tshangs pa'i gsung: snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs rigs drug 'dul thabs mdzad: gang 'tsham ma ṇi'i pad dbyangs sgrib sbyong ba'i: longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ras gzigs la bstod: hrī: byang chub thugs chud phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar: dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rang byung ba:

g.yas 'og bgrang phreng byang chub lam la 'dren: g.yon 'og padma 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral: skye bzhi rtsad gcod spyan ras gzigs la bstod: hrī: rin chen rus rgyan dar gyi cod pan 'phur: rdo rje skyil krung don la mnyam par bzhugs: snying rje'i mnga' bdag byams mgon spyan ras gzigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: chos dbyings ye shes rig pa rang byung lha: thugs rje khros pa rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal: sku mdog dmar nag dregs pa bdud bzhi 'dul: rngam brjid rang byung rta mchog sku la bstod: hrī: spyan gsum rab 'jigs sdang mig bgegs la bgrad: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ag tshom bskal me 'bar: dbu skra gyen brdzes thod skam rta mgos mtshan: 'jigs byed rta mgrin dbang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: dur khrod chas brgyad rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i sku: stobs bcu lhun rdzogs gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: zhabs gnyis dor stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs: drag po rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: phrin las bzhi sgrub rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo dang: dregs pa kun 'dul 'jigs byed rab tu khros: bdud bzhi'i dpung 'joms dpa' bo stag sham can: nyer bzhi dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i sku la bstod: hrī: stong nyid chos kyi dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku: thugs kyi rgyal ba skyed mdzad mkha' 'gro'i gtso: 'gro la bu ltar brtse ba'i mnga' bdag ma: gsang ye ḍā ki rnal 'byor ma la bstod: hrī: dug lnga rnam dag sku mdog dmar la 'tsher: spyan gsum rab bgrad rngam gtum khro mo'i sku: rus pa'i rgyan drug phar phyin drug dang ldan: kun tu bzang mo yum gyi sku la bstod: hrī: phyag g.yas cang te'u'i sgra yis dpa' bo sdud: dril bu'i sgra yis mkha' 'gro bran du 'khol: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod: tshad med bzhi ldan gar nyams bsgyur la bstod: hrī: sku mdog ma nges cha lugs cir yang sgyur:

bdag med chos dbyings gri gug thod khrag bsnams: 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo bzlog phyir rtse gsum brten: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang phrin las mdzad: bde spor dngos grub ster mdzad lha mo ste: las kun sgrub mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus pa: 'jig rten 'das kyang drag gtum rngam stabs can: drag shul khros pas dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i: chos skyong gter bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod:

ces pa rnams kyis bskyed pa'i rim pa rjes 'brel bcas song nas/ bzlas pa bya ba la/ ting nge 'dzin spyi mthun ni/ thugs kar padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i steng du hrīḥdamar po/ de'i mtha' skor du yi ge bcu pa'i sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas skor du 'khor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams mchod/ byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad tshur bsdus nas rang la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs nas 'phags pa'i skur gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: zhes yi ge bcu pa la bzlas pa'i dngos gzhi bya/ yang 'od zer sems can rnams la phog pas rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par bsam la/ badzra gu ru hya ghrī wa: dhu ma gha ye: ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi hūm̐: hrīṃ hrīṃ: zhes pa'i sham bu btags pa'ang ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar stong tshigs phul/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni yig bcu 'bum phrag bcu/ sham bu btags pa khri tsho gsum bzla bar bshad do// gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la/ dang po tshogs mchod ni/ dam tshig gi rdzas su 'os pa'i bza' btung rnams bsham/ chu chang nang mchod kyis bran la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ma dag 'bags btsog thams cad sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'dod yon lnga yis rab tu brgyan: longs spyod rgyan gyi tshogs gtor 'di: gu ru padma 'byung gnas dang: rig 'dzin lha tshogs thams cad la: zag med rgya chen tshogs mchod 'bul: bzhes la bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: badzra gu ru gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ma dag 'bags btsog thams cad sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'dod yon lnga yis rab tu brgyan: longs spyod rgyan gyi tshogs gtor 'di: dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yab: lha mchog thugs rje chen po la: zag med rgya chen tshogs mchod 'bul:

bzhes la rang rig rang zhal ston: ārya lo ke shwa ra gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ma dag 'bags btsog thams cad sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'dod yon lnga yis rab tu brgyan: longs spyod rgyan gyi tshogs gtor 'di: snang srid dbang sdud rta mchog dpal: rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo'i tshogs bcas la: zag med rgya chen tshogs mchod 'bul: bzhes nas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs: ha ya grī ba gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ma dag 'bags btsog thams cad sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'dod yon lnga yis rab tu brgyan: longs spyod rgyan gyi tshogs gtor 'di: skye med dbyings kyi yum chen mo: gsang chen ḍā ki'i lha tshogs la: zag med rgya chen tshogs mchod 'bul: bzhes nas nyams myong bde stong spor: dhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ma dag 'bags btsog thams cad sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'dod yon lnga yis rab tu brgyan: longs spyod rgyan gyi tshogs gtor 'di: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: chos skyong gter bdag rnams la 'bul: bzhes nas phyi nang bar chad sol: ma hā kā la e ka dzā ṭi: gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa khā hi: zhes dkyil 'khor lnga la rim bzhin byin gyis brlabs shing tshogs phud 'bul/ nang gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas tshogs bar pa rol/ lhag ma bsdus la bdud rtsis bran te/ byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ ho: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes: dbang mo nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa: lhag la dbang ba'i las byed mkha' 'gro rnams: 'dod yon lnga ldan lhag ma'i mchod pa 'di: dbang po'i yul du gang 'dod sna tshogs 'bul: rang gi bu smad gnyen 'dun spun bcas rnams: shes bya'i klong du re ba tshims gyur cig: badzra ratna padma karma shwa ra na sa ra ti ḍā ki nī bhyo khā hi:

zhes phyi rol du phul/ bka' gter srung ma la gtor 'bul yang gang 'os su sbyar/ bka'i chad mdo bskyang ba ni/ gtor ma btegs la/ hūm̐ bhyo: spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' nyan tshogs: gtsang rigs dpal mgon bdun cu dang: lha klu gnod sbyin srin po rnams: dam rdzas gtor ma 'di longs la: bcol pa'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: byur dang skal ngan mi mthun kun: dmar chen gtor mas bzlog cing sgyur: bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod: ces 'bul zhing phrin las bcol/ gtong rag gi mchod bstod ni/ sngags tsam gyis mchod/ hrī: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs mdzad pa: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: 'khor dang bcas la bstod par bgyi: zhes pas bstod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang: sogs dang yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bshags/ tshogs mgron sogs gshegs gsol lam brtan bzhugs gang 'thad bya/ snod bcud lhar gsal ba 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim par mos la mnyam par bzhag /slar yi ge bcu'i sgras thun mtshams kyi lhar ldangs la khyer so gsum gyi grub mtha' bskyang*/ bkra shis brjod pa ni/ me tog 'thor la/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: dbyings rig rang shar skye med don gyi lha: thugs rje byin rlabs nyi zla'i zer ltar 'phro: 'gro kun brtse bas skyong mdzad snying rje'i bdag: byams mgon spyan ras gzigs kyi bkra shis shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: byin rlabs mnga' bdag padma thod phreng rtsal: dpa' bo rta mgrin srid gsum 'dul ba'i gnyen: gsang ye ḍā ki gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso: rtsa gsum dbyer med mchog gi bkra shis shog: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kun sgrub pa'i: drag gtum rngam brjid bstan srung rgya mtsho rnams: sgrub la ma yis bu bzhin skyong mdzad pa'i: chos srung gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog:

bsngo smon ni/ ho: bdag gzhan dus gsum dge tshogs rnams: chos dbyings dmigs med klong du bsngo: tshogs gnyis dge rtsa bla med 'dis: khams gsum rigs drug ma lus kun: lhun grub zhing du sangs rgyas te: sku lnga'i 'bras bu thob par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐: zhes dang theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i bsngo smon rgyas par spel lo// 'phags mchog thugs rje'i nyin byed 'od 'bar bas// srid pa'i rgya mtsho chos kyi dbyings su skem// ye shes rig pa'i snang ba snying dbus su// sad nas 'khrul rtog mun pa dwangs gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang khyer bde'i slad du gter gzhung yig cha ma bu rnams dkyus gcig tu bsdebs te bklags pas grub par/ padma gar dbang phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal gyis 'phags pa'i bsti gnas chen po tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub sder bkod pa dge legs 'phel/// /
